policy: All 12 portfolio lanes have a progress event in this delta; evidence is lane-local and no result is promoted across lanes.

lanes.progress: Lowered the frozen ER6 p=1 mean-energy and CVaR candidates into provider-neutral OpenQASM 3 while preserving the six-qubit instance, hash, bit order and accepted-output contract; each candidate has 39 logical gate instructions (6 H, 18 CX, 9 RZ, 6 RX).
lanes.dependency: Provider-valid transpilation, physical layout/depth, current calibration, QPU output and stronger classical baseline remain absent.
lanes.next_cycle: Freeze a reproducible classical baseline and measure end-to-end time/resources against the same accepted-output contract.

lanes.progress: Checked the official AWS Braket Rigetti Cepheus tariff on 2026-09-28. Two 8,192-shot tasks produce $7.5632 task-plus-shot arithmetic; provider tariff is kept separate from execution evidence.
lanes.dependency: Full AWS/cloud bill, provider-matched execution/billing provenance, credentials, quote and authorization remain absent.
lanes.next_cycle: Update official terms/quote and provider-ready packet; preserve the no-job gate and do not mix providers.

lanes.progress: Computed exact output payload bounds for six measured bits and 8,192 shots: 49,152 raw bits (6,144 packed bytes) per candidate and 12,288 packed bytes for the pair; two bits label one of four accepted identities.
lanes.dependency: Provider serialization size and measured transfer, persistence, readout and decode time remain unknown.
lanes.next_cycle: Measure local serialization, persistence and decode bytes/times reproducibly; keep provider transfer values null absent a run.

lanes.progress: Recorded published distance-5 cat-code context: five storage modes, four syndrome ancillas and a 2.8 μs cycle; no project-side memory service contract is supplied.
lanes.dependency: No matched UQPU target, live calibration, hardware reproduction or source-level complete control/readout/decoder cost.
lanes.next_cycle: Define service/retention contract first; extract source-level control/readout/decoder resources and state device dependencies.

lanes.progress: Refreshed official ASTM D4935 catalog metadata: active D4935-18(2026), designation D4935-18R26, listed at $80 on 2026-09-28; page scope and uncertainty factors were recorded.
lanes.dependency: Full method text is unavailable to the project; no purchase authorization, matched material input, or project compliance evidence.
lanes.next_cycle: Use authorized text access if available; reconcile feedstock, resin and incumbent/candidate requirements before fabrication.

lanes.progress: Built a full-stack accepted-output cost schema; provider tariff arithmetic is isolated and all unknown bill, orchestration, queue, transfer/storage, retry, mitigation/decoder, energy/cooling, capital and acceptance-count fields remain null.
lanes.dependency: No provider bill or observed accepted-output denominator; classical baseline and lifecycle costs unmeasured.
lanes.next_cycle: Extend ledger with all provider, host, queue, storage, retry, mitigation, energy, labor and classical baseline components.

lanes.progress: Updated the no-fabrication readiness gate with current ASTM scope and catalog edition plus material, mismatch, dynamic-range and ancillary-equipment uncertainty factors.
lanes.dependency: Authenticated feedstock, fixed resin/hardener/cure, method access and metrology uncertainty remain unresolved; no fabrication or VNA measurement.
lanes.next_cycle: Complete a no-fabrication readiness review of provenance, resin/cure and uncertainty against the measurement range.

lanes.dependency: No decision-ready experimental evidence or costed capital proposal; this automation authorizes no spend.

lanes.progress: Recorded Putterman et al.'s reported 1.65±0.03% distance-5 logical error at |α|²=1.5 and 2.8 μs syndrome cycle. Derived TX≥42.424 μs only from the central value, nonnegative bit-flip probability and source equations.
lanes.dependency: No project target or retention horizon; raw Zenodo data were not extracted due rate limiting; the inference is not a confidence/lifetime result.
lanes.next_cycle: Retry primary-data retrieval and separate per-cycle error, lifetime, component rates and uncertainty before modeling a target.

lanes.progress: Generated deterministic CAL-001 synthetic fixture with 128 control and 128 known-interference trials, raw hashes and a replication schema. Fixed fixture detects all 128 injected cases with zero control triggers under a 4σ/2-of-6 rule; truth and trial ledger are labeled in the same artifact.
lanes.dependency: Synthetic counts do not estimate physical detector performance; bundle is unsealed at rest; independent site and human study are absent.
lanes.next_cycle: Design a two-party synthetic-only blinded handoff with separately controlled truth, a pre-frozen scorer and manifest; test unseal controls.

lanes.dependency: No functionally equivalent AI workload, measured incumbent baseline, provider bill or residual allowable-cost calculation.
lanes.next_cycle: Specify one functionally equivalent task, quality gate and baseline provenance before any residual-cost calculation.
